answer_2.quote: We adopted the same metrics as [reference] to evaluate the recommendation performance of all models: Precision, Recall, Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG), and Hit Rate (HR). ... we define the faithfulness to be the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence...

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we conduct a user study to evaluate the faithfulness of the explainable paths. ... We ask 20 human subjects to rank these methods based on whether the generated paths are consistent with those from the training set.
